model-list.json: opencode api model.list, with location.directory written as /tmp/repo
model-default.json: opencode api model.default, with location.directory written as /tmp/repo
notes: OpenCode found every Ollama tag by itself, named by its id. The version is the one installed when the list was recorded; it wasn't read again when the file was copied here. The key naming each model's line is left out, since nothing reads it.
sanitized: only stock Ollama tags kept; tests that need one named by OpenCode's config or held to a smaller window make it up in code (src/models/discovery/capped_twins.rs)
